messages:
morgan: Hey team — opened a PR for the user_events pipeline + schema change, can someone eyeball before I merge? https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123 :wave:

PR summary: add `session_type` (nullable smallint) to events.user_events, backfill for last 30 days, and a short streaming job change to emit session_type by looking up session metadata.

morgan: Key risk: backfill is ~90M rows on staging, planning to run batched UPDATEs and a streaming compensating job to backfill any late records. I added a migration guard and a feature flag so rollout can be toggled.

morgan: Migration SQL (rough):
```sql
ALTER TABLE events.user_events ADD COLUMN session_type SMALLINT;
-- backfill in 10k batches, id-based
UPDATE events.user_events SET session_type = s.type
FROM staging.session_meta s WHERE events.user_events.session_id = s.id
AND events.user_events.id BETWEEN $start AND $end;
```

morgan: Requested: quick look for schema safety, any locking concerns, and whether this backfill plan is reasonable for prod. Also need confirmation if this requires a coordinated deploy with app-side change (I think yes).

:taylor: On it, will skim now. Quick Q: did you add an explicit index on session_id? big JOINs without index = pain.

morgan: Good call — added `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ON events.user_events (session_id);` in migration. Left as concurrent to avoid locks.

:taylor: Nice. A few things to check: 
- make sure migration runs under low-traffic window (concurrent index helps but updates still write)
- consider doing backfill in background job that writes to a new table and then swap if update volume is high
- ensure replication lag won't blow up downstream consumers

morgan: Got it. For replication lag, plan is to monitor replica lag and pause backfill if > 5s. Backfill job reports lag and aborts.

samira: Can you add a rolling deploy note in the PR description? curious how app will tolerate missing column pre-merge (should be fine if code reads with coalesce). Also add a short smoke-test query I can run.

morgan: Added smoke test snippet to PR: 
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events.user_events WHERE session_type IS NULL AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour';
```
If count stays ~0 after rollout then backfill likely covered new traffic.

harper: CI looks green, but can you include EXPLAIN ANALYZE for the JOIN on a 30-day sample? want to see I/O and potential sequential scans.

morgan: Pushed sample explain from staging (trimmed):
```
Hash Join  (cost=..)
  -> Seq Scan on session_meta (cost=..)
  -> Index Scan using user_events_session_id_idx on user_events ...
```
Looks okay — no full table scan on user_events thanks to the concurrent index.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline passed for pr/4123 — unit tests: 82 passed, integration: 14 passed, schema migration check: ok. :white_check_mark:

harper: If the sample explain looks good, I can give a quick approval after you add the rollout play and the abort-on-lag guard. Also please add a short runbook step for abort and resume.

morgan: Added runbook blurb and abort/resume commands. Also included the feature-flag toggle command for ops.

:taylor: another small ask — add a short test to the pipeline that runs the backfill on a tiny dataset to catch regressions.

morgan: Will do, adding a tiny backfill integration test.

harper: Cool. I can approve in ~30m if smoke tests pass on staging.

morgan: Thanks — I'll hold merge until approvals and a brief staging smoke. Planning a production backfill during the 02:00 UTC window if all green. Will ping here right before starting.

samira: ACK, will stand by for the smoke-run and to run validation queries. :thumbsup:
